### Valley of diversity.

#### Valley of surprises.

Together with the neighboring Czech Podyjí National Park, the Thayatal National Park preserves one of the last natural valley landscapes in Central Europe. In a very small area, the Thaya has created habitats and forest types with a surprising diversity. Over 40% of all plant species found in Austria and a large number of endangered animal species, such as the European wildcat, the black stork and the noble crayfish, are at home here.

The Thayatal National Park offers an ideal environment to discover with mindfulness what makes the untouched nature in the Thayatal National Park so extraordinary.

### Hiking & cycling trails

(c) C. Ebner

![forest path](https://www.np-thayatal.at/pages/en/330/WaldBRNP-Thayatal-Claudia-Ebner-54.jpg)

100 km of hiking and cycling trails can be discovered in the Thayatal-Podyjí National Park. Our hiking trails for walkers, families as well as skilled hikers lead through soft meadows, sparse rocky locations and cool lush green forests along the river and streams.



[Hiking & cycling trails![](https://www.np-thayatal.at/images/icons/arrow-right-s-green.svg)](https://www.np-thayatal.at/en/pages/hiking--cycling-trails-426.aspx)

(c) C. Ebner

(c) C. Milek

### Rent a Ranger

(c) C. Milek

![ranger with binoculars on the river thaya](https://www.np-thayatal.at/pages/en/331/Weiterbildung-GraeserMilek-22.JPG)

Discover the most remote corners of the National Park, find the most inconspicuous details of nature, listen to the most interesting stories from our rangers!



### European wildcat

(c) C. Ebner

![a genetically proven wild cat](https://www.np-thayatal.at/pages/en/332/20181008-Wildkatze-Frieda-CarloBR-NP-ThayatalC--Ebner-15.jpg)

Shy, hidden and rarely seen, it lives in the forests of the Thayatal National Park. At the wildcat facility next to the National Park House you can observe the elegance and wildness of these rare wild animals. Therefore, a visit to Frieda & Carlo must not be missed!



[To the wildcat facility![](https://www.np-thayatal.at/images/icons/arrow-right-s-green.svg)](https://www.np-thayatal.at/en/pages/european-wildcat-facility-435.aspx)
